name: Operational Runbook
description: A step-by-step runbook for a repeatable operational process or procedure
layout_notes: Each step should be numbered. Include expected output and error handling for each major step. Use callout boxes for warnings and tips.

required_sections.title: Document Header
required_sections.description: Runbook title, process owner, version, last reviewed date, audience

required_sections.title: Overview
required_sections.description: What this runbook does, when to use it, and expected outcome

required_sections.title: Prerequisites
required_sections.description: Access, tools, credentials, or conditions required before starting

required_sections.title: Steps
required_sections.description: Numbered step-by-step instructions with commands, screenshots, or decision points

required_sections.title: Verification
required_sections.description: How to confirm the process completed successfully

required_sections.title: Rollback / Recovery
required_sections.description: What to do if something goes wrong

required_sections.title: Escalation
required_sections.description: Who to contact if the runbook fails or an unexpected situation arises

instance_inputs.label: Description of the steps or process to document
